assets.prompt: Create a premium technical textbook front-cover artwork, portrait 2:3 aspect. Title to render precisely in beautiful restrained modern typography in upper half: 'PRODUCTION\nOPTIMIZATION' and beneath smaller 'Oil and Gas Fields Using NeqSim'. At bottom 'Even Solbraa' and very small '2026 · Revised Edition'. Editorial scientific illustration, sophisticated dark navy and ivory with copper orange and pale cyan accents. A realistic integrated offshore production system in the lower two-thirds: an elegant detailed offshore topside platform at the sea surface, beneath it a precise artistic ocean cutaway revealing subsea wellheads connected by pipelines and risers to the platform, and reservoir geological layers deep below. A subtle mathematically inspired contour surface transitioning into a sparse optimization curve in the open upper-right background; ornamental, no fake equations, no fake data, no unreadable equipment labels. Large generous negative space for perfect readable title; typography and industrial art should feel like a high-end university engineering monograph. Physically plausible platform and subsea arrangement, no dramatic disaster imagery, no logos, no badges, no watermarks. Crisp fine details, publication-quality raster art.
assets.purpose: Cover art; illustrative, no computed data

assets.prompt: High-end scientific textbook illustration, wide landscape 3:2. An accurate conceptual cutaway of a horizontal three-phase oil/gas/water separator, on a clean warm ivory background. Polished technical editorial rendering, coherent navy outlines and restrained copper, teal, pale blue. Long horizontal cylindrical pressure vessel supported by two saddles, with left inlet nozzle and inlet momentum dissipator, large calm gas space above, distinct upper amber oil layer and lower blue water layer below, oil overflow weir toward right, separate water outlet from bottom before weir and oil outlet after weir, wire-mesh demister near gas outlet at upper right. Metal shell partly removed so internals clearly visible; transparent subtle arrows show gas going above to demister and liquid settling downward. No text whatsoever, no numbers, no invented labels, no charts. Clean physically plausible geometry and sensible piping, subtle shadows, ample whitespace, precise materials and clear phase separation. This is explanatory artwork for production optimization, not an engineering fabrication drawing. Publication quality, sharp and readable at book page size.
assets.purpose: Conceptual separator illustration; not a mechanical drawing

assets.prompt: Wide landscape scientific editorial illustration for an advanced oil and gas production optimization textbook. One large electric motor at left drives a long horizontal shaft into a cylindrical compressor casing at right, compressor shell partly removed to reveal five successive radial impellers and stationary return channels on the same horizontal shaft. Inlet pipe at first stage and discharge pipe at last stage clearly separated. Thin subtle pale cyan flow arrows indicate progression along successive stages; machine metal in pale steel grey, darker navy outlines, restrained copper impellers. Include a small oil lubrication console subtly behind the baseplate. No text, no numerical data, no plots, no logos, no labels. Visually plausible machinery, accurate mechanical proportions, textbook clarity over dramatic photorealism, clean technical materials and shadows, lots of whitespace, high-quality publication artwork. Conceptual illustration only, not a fabrication drawing.
assets.purpose: Conceptual multistage compressor illustration; not a vendor map or manufacturing section
